postCreator.title: Post Creator
postCreator.description: Generate post images with AI from a text prompt.

chat.emptyDescription: Type @ to attach the large preview or a media library image, then ask about composition, styling, or what to change next. You can also ask the assistant to generate a new post image.
chat.placeholder: Ask about attached images or generate a new post… Type @ to attach preview or media
chat.errorDescription: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
chat.clearChatTooltip: Clear messages and start a fresh chat thread

mentionMenu.empty: No matching preview or media to attach
mentionMenu.mediaEmpty: No media files yet. Upload images on the Media page.

settings.title: Generation settings
settings.safeZoneHelper: Preview margins only — they are not applied to the generated image. Toggle the guide in the preview footer.
settings.solidBackgroundHelper: When enabled and no previous image is used, a flat color canvas at the current output size is sent as the first reference.

history.emptyDescription: Generation history for this page appears in the preview when you have multiple versions.

prompt.label: Creative direction
prompt.placeholder:
headline: Setiap Hari
products: Ref 2 → Roti Bluder, Ref 3 → Ice Americano

Type @ to attach product photos in order.

style.label: Style pack
style.description: Applied automatically to this generation — you don’t need to repeat style rules in the prompt.

usage.title: How to use this style
usage.intro: Override properties in the brief with tags like [property=value]. Multi-word params use quotes.
usage.fallbackEnum: Choose one of the listed values.
usage.fallbackText: Set a short text token (no spaces in the main value).

model.label: Image model
model.description: Leonardo model used for this generation.

flash.name: Nano Banana
flash.blurb: Fast and cost-efficient. Strong at multi-reference edits; good default for iteration.

nanoBanana2.name: Nano Banana 2
nanoBanana2.blurb: Balanced speed and quality. Better texture, text, and consistency than original Nano Banana.

pro.name: Nano Banana Pro
pro.blurb: Highest instruction following for complex multi-reference edits. Slower and uses more tokens.

picker.empty: No matching media. Upload one or add files in Media.
picker.uploadError: Couldn’t upload that file. Try again.
picker.maxReached: Maximum reference photos reached (5). Remove one to add another.

generation.referenceSummaryTextOnly: Next generation: creative direction only (no references).
generation.referenceSummaryFilledEdit: Next generation: edit the image in preview only.
generation.referenceSummaryPreviousOnly: Next generation: edit the image in preview.
generation.referenceSummaryPhotosOnly: Next generation: {count, plural, one {# checked photo} other {# checked photos}}.
generation.referenceSummaryPreviousAndPhotos: Next generation: image in preview + {count, plural, one {# checked photo} other {# checked photos}}.
generation.referenceSummarySolidBackgroundAndPhotos: Next generation: solid background ({color}) + {count, plural, one {# checked photo} other {# checked photos}}.
generation.tooManyReferences: Too many references selected. Use at most 5 checked product photos (plus previous image or solid background when used).

tip.title: Tip
tip.description: The image in the preview is used as the edit reference. Pick a generated version to edit that result. Optionally add product photos with @, then describe changes in creative direction.

preview.emptyDescription: Enter a prompt in the panel on the right and generate an image.
preview.safeZoneDescription: Shows preview margins of {insetX}px from the left and right edges and {insetY}px from the top and bottom edges so you can check that important content stays inside the safe area.
preview.versionOptionPostImagePreviewLabel: Generated image {current} of {total}, post image and previewing
preview.deleteConfirmDescription: This removes the image from this page's version history. This cannot be undone.
preview.removePageConfirmDescription: This removes the empty page from your post. This cannot be undone.

toast.loadError: Failed to load post. Please refresh and try again.
toast.generateError: Failed to generate post image. Please try again.
toast.leonardoError: AI processing failed. Check your Leonardo API key and model, then try again.
toast.leonardoInsufficientTokens: Leonardo reported insufficient API credits or tokens. Add credits in your Leonardo account or API billing, then try again.
toast.imageSelectError: Failed to update post image. Please try again.
toast.saveSettingsError: Failed to save post settings. Please try again.
toast.deleteImageError: Failed to delete image. Please try again.
toast.deletePageError: Failed to remove page. Please try again.
toast.addPageError: Failed to add page. Please try again.
toast.maxPagesReached: Instagram carousels support up to 10 images.
